slots.ai_fallback_prompt:
Kling 3.0 text-to-video · 9:16 vertical · Pro · Sound OFF · 3 s. Photoreal vertical phone b-roll, locked-off at hand height about 30 cm above a bright bathroom vanity, soft morning window light from camera-left, natural warm colours, light grain, not glossy. Softly out-of-focus background: the white basin edge low in frame, a plain white ceramic toothbrush cup on the right third, a warm cream wall. The garment: plain black seamless matte-satin microfibre briefs (soft low sheen, never glossy): laser-cut raw edges at the waist and leg openings with no elastic band, a smooth flat front panel, short ruched gathers on the side seams, mid-rise full-brief cut, no lace, no logo, no label, no print, no visible stitching. 0.0-0.3 s: a woman's hands (early 30s, fair skin with light freckles, short natural unpolished nails, one thin gold band, bare forearms) bring the briefs in from just below frame centre with a soft motion and settle them in the centre about 20 cm from the lens, held by the waistband, front panel to camera, in sharp focus: exactly the framing of the opening shot, with clean cream wall in the top third. 0.8 s: a small gentle stretch of the waistband outward and back. Hold steady to 3 s with a gentle handheld micro-drift. Only hands and forearms in frame, no face, no body.
Negative prompt: lace, logo, text, captions, label, care tag, elastic waistband, thong, bikini cut, high-cut leg, grey, navy, brown, pink or lavender fabric, glossy or shiny fabric, stains, liquid, red or blue fluid, period framing, face, body, extra fingers, fused fingers, extra hands, morphing or melting fabric, flicker, watermark.
If the PRODUCT-STORE / PRODUCT-REAL photos exist, run this same text as image-to-video from a Nano Banana Pro start frame built on them: it holds the garment far better than text alone.

group_notes:
THE STOCK LIBRARIES CAN'T SUPPLY OUR PRODUCT. Pexels, Pixabay, Mixkit and Coverr have no clip of a plain BLACK full brief being handled; black underwear only appears worn by models (faces, bodies) or as lace sets. The closest stand-in is Pexels 8783681: a lavender-grey seamless bonded brief (raw cut edges, no elastic band, mid-rise full brief) held by the waistband, front to camera, by fair, ringless, natural-nail hands on a plain grey wall. Its sister clip 8783680 (blush, same shoot, but tan tattooed forearms and red nails) is the backup and the only clip with a turn.
1) ANIMATIC / ROUGH CUT ONLY. A grey or pink brief in an ad that sells black underwear misrepresents the product (Meta 'misleading' risk, plus refund complaints). The launch cut needs the real CJ sample (SKU CJNSNYNK00343) filmed on the phone, or the AI prompts (best run as image-to-video from PRODUCT-STORE/PRODUCT-REAL start frames).
2) ONE CLIP FOR ALL HOLDS: S2 (4.85-6.05), S12 (0.20-3.35) and S18 (6.10-6.90) all come from 8783681 in non-overlapping windows, ALL flipped horizontally, same full-height 9:16 crop scale (0.316 of width), same grade. S2 and S18 share the crop x 0.455-0.771, and S18's window carries straight on from S2's, so the bookend matches the hook. The held brief is ~0.42 of the frame wide, so the crop always clips it: it reads as an at-lens CU with a hand at each edge. Don't scale the whole hold to fit 9:16 (the brief drops into the bottom third, under the Reels UI). Never cut 8783680 against 8783681 inside one sequence (different hands, skin, nails and colour).
3) GRADE: lift warmth +8 and tint slightly toward cream so the cool grey studio sits closer to the warm vanity/S1 look. Optionally key the flat grey wall and comp the hands + brief over a defocused S1 vanity plate, which hides the location jump across the wipes. Recolour for the animatic: a DaVinci Resolve qualifier on the lavender hue (Gain ~0.15, Sat 0) gives a believable charcoal; CapCut HSL only reaches dark grey. 8783681 is really 1280x720 (Pexels labels the file 1080p), so the 9:16 crop is a 2.7x upscale: sharpen 10-15 + fine grain, and the whip blur covers the softness.
4) FLAT-LAYS (S16, S17) = NO STOCK. Nothing top-down shows a brief being smoothed or flipped on linen. They need a 10-minute overhead phone shoot on Warm Cream linen with the sample (ref photos #1/#2 are exactly these frames), or Kling start/end frames from those refs. Their backups are timeline placeholders only.
5) REAL SHOOT ORDER (one session, one hand model: fair skin, short natural nails, thin gold band): S1/S2/S11/S12/S18 on the tripod at the vanity, then S16/S17 overhead. That's the 5 H5b product shots plus the S1/S11 liner takes, about 30 minutes.
6) AI PROMPTS: all five lock the garment with the project's wording (plain black seamless matte-satin microfibre, soft low sheen, laser-cut raw edges with no elastic band, smooth front panel, short ruched side gathers, mid-rise full-brief cut, no lace, logo or label) and the same hand (fair, light freckles, natural nails, thin gold band). Paste each 'Negative prompt' line into Kling's negative field. Nothing was generated.
